settings.title: Shipping
settings.content:
Fast Australia-wide Shipping (4-10 days), Tasmania (10-20 days).

Shipping price is calculated automatically at checkout, for enquiries contact on support@vulcanfitness.com.au. 

The delivery service is a curb side / threshold delivery service, if you are after a quote for delivery and installation go to the Installation drop down.

Brisbane collection: collect from Unit 2A/919-925 Nudgee Road, Banyo QLD 4014, Monday to Friday 8.30am–5pm.

Regional? We can often send to a depot near you for less. Email us at support@vulcanfitness.com.au. Shipping & delivery details

settings.title: Installation
settings.content:
We have delivery & installation services across Australia. 

Email support@vulcanfitness.com.au with the items you'd like installed and we'll quote installation and delivery together! or ask us about a full-gym fit-out. See installation rates

Below is a PDF installation manual if you are installing the machine yourself.

settings.title: Warranty
settings.content:
Frame: 5 years · Cables: 2 years · Upholstery: 2 years

*If your equipment suffers a defect within the warranty period, we will replace, repair or refund your order*

Warranty & returns policy

settings.title: 90 Day Love It or Leave It
settings.content:
Try it in your home or facility for 90 days. If you don't love it, contact us to organise a return and we'll refund the product once it's back in our warehouse. Shipping and return costs aren't refunded, and equipment must come back in its original packaging.

Read the full returns policy

settings.title: Commercial warranty
settings.content:
Warranty: 

  • Frame 5 years
  • Cables 2 years 
  • Upholstery 2 years
  • Other Parts 2 years

This does not cover any minor cosmetic damages to the frame, padding, or paint coating.  Warranty details
